method: Producer left 'method' as the literal 'placeholder'. From its evidence tags: [review]/[audit] entries are HW1 string-matcher candidates (ghidra/exports/cataclysm_gog_hw1match/hw1_string_matches.csv) checked by hand against HomeworldSDL source, several correcting the matcher; [callee] entries were found from the callers or callees of confirmed functions. Audit: 30 entries were drawn with random.seed(7), stratified by confidence (29 high, 1 medium). Each was checked against its decompile, strings.csv, call_graph.csv and the named HomeworldSDL function. 30 were correct, 0 wrong, 0 unverifiable.
